As of 2015, UNESCO data put global adult literacy (ages 15 and over) at about 86%, so I'd stand by my earlier answer. Neither of the team's options, 81% or 96%, matches that figure, though 81% is closer. I can't check the team note against a source here, so I'd verify it against the UNESCO Institute for Statistics literacy data before relying on either option.
CONFIDENCE: 75
